evidence: New Resume creates "Untitled Resume" with blank contact, summary, empty experience/education lists, and "No skills added yet" message; all fields immediately editable.

Edited contact fields and summary; added/edited/reordered(move-up)/removed work experience entries; added/edited education entry; added, changed level of, and removed skills. All state changes reflected correctly in editor.
Switched Modern→Classic→Minimal; preview styling changed (uppercase headings, different separators) each time while all contact/summary/experience/education/skills content remained intact.
Throughout editing (contact fields, summary, experience, education, skills, template switch), the preview reflected each change instantly without any save/refresh action.
Moved Experience section above Summary via move-up; preview order updated accordingly. Toggled Skills section visibility off; preview hid Skills section entirely; toggled back on and it reappeared.
Reordered Experience above Summary and preview updated instantly; navigated back to dashboard and reopened resume — order (Experience, Summary, Education, Skills) and visibility persisted.

Edited contact/summary/experience/education/skills, navigated between tabs, returned to dashboard (card showed "Updated Aug 25, 2026" reflecting the edit), reopened resume — all edits and section order were retained.

Contact details, summary, experience (Acme Corp/Senior Engineer), education (State University), and skills (React) all remained present after switching tabs, returning to dashboard, and reopening the resume.
Clicked "Hide Preview" — preview region disappeared, editor fields (contact values) remained. Clicked "Show Preview" — preview reappeared with all content and Minimal template intact.

Added 4 experience entries with long descriptions causing preview content (2018px) to exceed viewport (720px); all sections/entries including the last "Developer Four" entry remained present in DOM and were reachable by scrolling the page to the bottom.

issue: Invalid date range (end before start) is accepted without rejection or feedback
actual: Set Start Date=2020-01, End Date=2019-01 on a work experience entry. No validation message, error styling, or aria-invalid appeared; the value was accepted and the preview rendered "Jan 2020 Jan 2019" as-is instead of rejecting the invalid period.

evidence: Dates render as consistent "Mon YYYY" format (e.g. "Jan 2020"). Checking "I currently work here" cleared the End Date value and disabled the field (enabled:false); preview showed "Jan 2020 Present". Unchecking restored the editable end-date field.

issue: Customized section heading not rendered in Minimal style
actual: Renamed Summary heading to "About Me" and Experience heading to "Career History". In Modern and Classic styles both customized headings render correctly. In Minimal style, "Career History" renders but the Summary section shows only the paragraph text with no heading at all — the customized "About Me" title is missing even though the section is visible.

issue: Whitespace-only title is rejected silently with no validation feedback
actual: Entered "   " (whitespace only) into the resume title field and confirmed with both Tab and Enter. The title correctly reverted to "Untitled Resume" (previous value preserved), but no toast, inline error message, or any other validation feedback was shown to the user (Notifications regions remained empty).

evidence: Renamed resume to "Software Engineer - TechCo Application"; editor title showed the new name and the dashboard card for the same resume (mv7hxtsmb6) displayed the identical title.

Duplicated "Software Engineer - TechCo Application" via card menu → created "(Copy)" with identical content. Renamed copy to "Software Engineer - Beta Corp Application" via Rename dialog. Edited copy's full name to "Jane Doe-Beta"; original resume's full name remained "Jane Doe" unaffected.

Edited copy's contact name to "Jane Doe-Beta" — original stayed "Jane Doe". Then edited original's name to "Jane Doe-Original" — copy stayed "Jane Doe-Beta", confirming independence in both directions.

Dashboard shows 5 distinct resumes created/managed during the session (3 pre-existing + 1 newly created "Software Engineer - TechCo Application" + 1 duplicated/renamed "Software Engineer - Beta Corp Application"), each independently editable.

Searching "marketing" (lowercase) matched "Marketing Manager Resume" (case-insensitive). Clearing search restored all 5 resumes. Sorting "Oldest First" ordered results Jan 2024→Aug 2026; "Newest First" reversed it.

actual: Inspected the dashboard (including hidden elements) — only a title search box and a sort-order dropdown (Newest/Oldest/Title A-Z/Z-A) are present. There is no control to filter by an exact creation date or a date range, and no way to clear such a criterion, since it doesn't exist.

issue: No changes persist across a page reload
actual: Before reload, dashboard had 4 resumes: original 3 defaults minus deleted "Product Designer Resume", plus created "Software Engineer - TechCo Application" and its renamed duplicate "Software Engineer - Beta Corp Application". After reloading http://localhost:6005/, the dashboard reverted to exactly the original 3 default resumes (Software Engineer Resume, Marketing Manager Resume, Product Designer Resume) — the newly created resume and its duplicate/rename were gone, and the deleted "Product Designer Resume" reappeared. None of create, edit, duplicate, rename, or delete operations survived a reload.
